questionText:
Arrange the sequential zones along a river as it recovers downstream from a massive point-source sewage discharge (Streeter-Phelps Oxygen Sag):
(I) Clean Zone: high dissolved oxygen (DO > 8 mg/L) and low biological oxygen demand
(II) Zone of Degradation: sewage influx triggers explosive bacterial bloom, DO plummets rapidly, BOD surges
(III) Zone of Active Decomposition: DO reaches lowest critical minimum (septic conditions), sludge worms and anaerobic bacteria dominate
(IV) Zone of Recovery followed by Clean Zone: natural re-aeration replenishes DO, organic load is fully assimilated, game fish return
